findings.detail: AI Altius Bidco, Inc. first-lien private credit row has stored interest_rate blank, but the source schedule states 9.75% PIK in the interest-rate column.

rationale: The flagged extracted holding for AI Altius Bidco, Inc. has no interest_rate or basis_spread, but the matching source schedule row shows Reference Rate and Spread 9.75% and Interest Rate 9.75% PIK for the 12/21/2029 position. The missing extracted rate is therefore a source-grounded extraction gap, not a false alarm.
